## What's new in 1.12.3

**Internet calls (all apps)**
- **Switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data no longer breaks internet calls.** After a switch, Check network said "NAT: unknown (no STUN server answered)" until internet calls were turned off and on: the app kept the network socket it had opened on the old network. Now each network change opens a new one (a call still running on the old one keeps it until it ends), a socket the system broke is replaced, and STUN is asked again while the new network comes up.
